  "summary": "This one-page UNI news brief, published in the Indian Express on 4 May 1978, reports that major political parties occupying government accommodation in New Delhi had accumulated unpaid rent. The information was given by Sikander Bakht, the Minister for Works and Housing, in reply to a question in the Rajya Sabha.\n\nThe brief records arrears as of 31 March for several parties, including the Swatantra Party, Jana Sangh, DMK, CPI, CPI(M), and Janata Party. The figures cited include Rs. 5,898 for the Swatantra Party, Rs. 456 for the CPI, Rs. 2,281 for the CPI(M), and Rs. 1,888 for the Janata Party.
